case_notes.content: Reached out to Mr. Freeman and scheduled him for orientation this Friday.

Intake Screening: Jayhova Freeman
Date: 10/26/2026 | Center: Spartanburg | Screener: Daisy Boynton

Housing
Lives in an apartment and expects to stay there for the near future.

Documents

Birth certificate: Yes
Social Security card: Yes
State ID: Yes
Driver’s license: Suspended because of one unpaid ticket. He has a car to drive once it's reinstated.

Transportation
His girlfriend will be his main ride. He’ll use Uber as a backup when she can’t drive him. I gave him the center address (111 Belton Drive) and reminded him that relying on Uber gets expensive.

Health & Substance Use

No prescribed medications in the past 5 years.
No emergency or health needs reported.
No history of major alcohol abuse.
Has used marijuana only. I told him the weekly drug test includes marijuana and offered to delay his orientation if needed. He said he’ll pass and noted he’s already drug tested on probation.

Justice Involvement

First arrest at age 22. Arrested twice total, convicted once (the most recent arrest).
Released from county jail about a month ago (around late September 2026) after serving 3 months.
His charge didn’t involve drug trafficking or firearm possession.
No pending charges.
He’s on federal supervision, with a projected end date of 2/18/2027. He reports he’s in full compliance.
Biological parent(s) have a criminal record (he said “pretty sure”).

Family/Financial

Has a child.
Owes no child support.

Education & Employment

Highest education completed: sophomore year of college.
Legally and physically able to work, with no limitations.
Work history:
Bentley Automotive, about 1 year (most recent job). It ended because of incarceration.
Copark (likely Copart), about 3 years (his longest job). He left because he had a child and had to move.
Holds a current cherry picker certification (license card).

Program Fit

He’s available 9–3, Monday through Friday, with no conflicts.
I explained the First Shift structure:
$450/week stipend, with the first payment at the end of week 2.
$9 deducted for each missed point.
Weekly drug testing.
Morning CBT class, then SkillCat training and forklift certification.
Case management throughout.
Job placement after 8 weeks.
He asked what the classes cover, and I answered.

Plan / Next Steps

Added to the waitlist as #2. Orientation call is expected within 1–2 weeks.
Matt or Diyoung will call him. He needs to call back within 24 hours if he misses the call.
Orientation is usually Fridays at 3 PM.
He declined pre-program support (resume, license reinstatement). I’ll update him as his orientation gets closer.
For his case manager: license reinstatement (pay off the ticket) and his interest in automotive/auction-type work.
